card.name: Auxiliary verbs before "been reported"
card.fires_on: Small helper words such as "have", "has" or "also" that come right before "been reported" or "occurred" in adverse-event statements. It also fires on a few nouns like "experience" or "trials" that lead into such a statement.

modes.label: Have/has before been reported
modes.description: The helper verb sits after a subject and just before "been reported" or "been found".
modes.example: Lactic acidosis and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis, including fatal cases,<< have>> been reported with the use of nucleos

modes.label: Also before been reported
modes.description: The adverb "also" comes before "been reported" in a sentence about events seen in other groups.
modes.example: However, cardiac events have<< also>> been reported in adults and children without underlying

modes.label: Setting nouns leading into findings
modes.description: A noun such as "trials" or "experience" that introduces where adverse reactions were seen.
modes.example: In postmarketing<< experience>>, QT prolongation and Torsades
